legend: The only difference between the easy version and the hard version of the problem is the constraints on n$$$n$$$, k$$$k$$$, and ai$$$a_i$$$.

It's the year 2125, and e-archaeologists have uncovered remnants of what they believe was known as the "troll face". They believe that the troll face was represented by a non-degenerate k$$$k$$$-sided polygon that could be inscribed in a circle.

So far, the e-archaeologists have discovered n$$$n$$$ line segments, each of which has a length ai$$$a_i$$$. Now, the e-archaeologists are wondering: how many k$$$k$$$-size subsets of their n$$$n$$$ line segments could be used to create a troll face? Output your answer in mod 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$.
Consider all line segments to be unique, even if 2 have the same length.
input: The first line of input contains 2 integers, n$$$n$$$ and k$$$k$$$ (3≤k≤n≤100$$$3\le k\le n\le 100$$$) — the number of line segments and the number of sides in a troll face, respectively.
The second line of input contains n$$$n$$$ integers, a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ (1≤ai≤104$$$1\le a_i\le 10^4$$$) — the lengths of the n$$$n$$$ line segments.
output: Output a single integer in mod 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$, the number of k$$$k$$$-size subsets that could be used to create a troll face.

截至目前，电子考古学家发现了 n$$$n$$$ 条线段，每条线段的长度为 ai$$$a_i$$$。现在，他们想知道：从这 n$$$n$$$ 条线段中选出 k$$$k$$$ 条，能组成巨魔脸的方案有多少种？请输出答案对 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$ 取模的结果。
即使两条线段长度相同，也将它们视为不同的线段。
